_comment: GENERATED by packages/clients/scripts/generate.js from the contract's TOOLS (channel: bundled). Do not hand-edit — run `npm run clients:generate`. CI fails if this drifts from the contract, which is what stops the bundled server from answering with a tool surface the hub does not have.
instructions: Two read-only greeting tools, answered from pure local logic. No network, no state, no credential. Call greeting_hello to open, then greeting_day_check with what the user said back.

tools.name: greeting_hello
tools.title: Greet someone and ask how their day is going
tools.description: Returns a time-of-day salutation (morning/afternoon/evening, or a neutral 'Hello' late at night) followed by "How's your day going so far?". Pass a name to personalise it, and an hour (0-23) to greet for a specific time instead of the server clock.

name.description: Who to greet. Omitted for an impersonal greeting.

hour.description: Hour of day 0-23. Defaults to the server clock.

tools.name: greeting_day_check
tools.title: Respond to how someone's day is going
tools.description: Reads a free-text answer to 'How's your day going?', classifies it as positive, negative, or neutral, and returns a matching reply. Use after greeting_hello.

answer.description: What they said about their day, e.g. 'pretty good' or 'rough, very tired'.

name.description: Who answered. Used to personalise the reply.
